description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Master Mode], [Master Mode: Mog (Dragoon)], [Instant ATB 1] to user, grants [200% ATB 1] to all allies, grants [Learning Mode: Mog II] to all allies if there are at least 4 Dragoon party members, otherwise grants [Learning Mode: Mog] and [Soul Break Gauge +50] to all allies

description.name: Master Mode: Mog (Dragoon)
description.text: Casts [Star Strike: Mog] every 2s (max 5), casts [North Star: Narshe Hero's Spear] after 15s, removed if user hasn't Master Mode

description.name: Star Strike: Mog
description.text: If the user has [Learning Mode: Mog II], ten single ranged, jump, physical attacks (0.90 each) and increases Learning Mode: Mog II level for all allies. Otherwise, ten single magical attacks (0.90 each), grants [Stoneskin: 10%] to all allies, and increases Learning Mode: Mog level for all allies.

description.name: Learning Mode: Mog II
description.text: Keeps track of Learning Mode: Mog II level (0~5), Dragoon ability damage +25/30/35/40/45/50% at Learning Mode: Mog II level 0/1/2/3/4/5

description.name: Stoneskin: 10%
description.text: Reduces damage taken to 0, up to an amount equal to 10% of the character's maximum HP, removed when that amount is reached

description.name: Master Mode
description.text: Instant cast speed and no cost for the first Soul Break cast, grants [Hero Boost] and sets the Hero Boost level to 1 when set

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: 200% ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x2.00

description.name: Learning Mode: Mog
description.text: Keeps track of Learning Mode: Mog level (0~5), Damage +5/10/15/20/25/30% at Learning Mode: Mog level 0/1/2/3/4/5

description.name: Soul Break Gauge +50
description.text: Grants 50 soul break points when set

description.name: North Star: Narshe Hero's Spear
description.text: One single attack (8.00 each) capped at 199,999, ranged, jump. Grants [Weakness +30% Boost 1] to all allies.

description.name: Weakness +30% Boost 1
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 30% when exploiting elemental weaknesses
